source: USDA WWEIA food categories 2021-2023 (unmerged) + KnowD1 additions X01-X11

rules.title: One category
rules.text: Every product gets exactly one category: the one that best describes what the product **is**, as sold (packaged foods) or as eaten (dishes).

rules.title: Processing is a tag
rules.text: Fresh, frozen, canned, dried, raw or cooked do **not** change the category (frozen broccoli → 6407, canned peaches → 6008). Record the state as a tag. Exception: dried fruit has its own category (6016).

rules.title: Uncooked staples
rules.text: Dry or uncooked staples go to the category of the food they become: dry pasta → 4004, dry rice → 4002, dried lentils → 2802, rolled oats → 4802.

rules.title: Ready meals and kits
rules.text: Ready meals, frozen meals and meal kits go to the dish they make: frozen pizza → 3602, lasagna → 3204, taco kit → 3502, risotto kit → 3202.

rules.title: Single food vs dish
rules.text: A single food with only seasoning, marinade or sauce stays in its own category (marinated chicken breast → 2202, tuna in oil → 2402). Combined with other foods (pasta, rice, vegetables, bread) it becomes a dish (31xx–38xx).

rules.title: Sandwiches and wraps
rules.text: Sandwiches, wraps and subs go to the 37xx category of their **main filling**.

rules.title: Use the nutrition values
rules.text: Some categories split on nutrients; use the product's values per 100 g / 100 ml. **Milk fat**: whole ≥ 3.0 g, reduced fat 1.8–2.9 g, lowfat 0.6–1.7 g (incl. European semi-skimmed 1.5 %), nonfat < 0.6 g; unknown → reduced fat. **Ready-to-eat cereal**: sugars > 21.2 g → 4602, otherwise 4604. **Diet drinks** (71xx): ≤ 1 g sugars per 100 ml and sweetened with non-nutritive sweeteners ("zero", "diet", "light", "sugar-free").

rules.title: Biscuit
rules.text: "Biscuit" means a cookie in UK/European usage (→ 5504) but a bread-like quick bread in US usage (→ 4402). Decide from the product, not the word.

rules.title: Plant-based alternatives
rules.text: Milk alternatives → 1902, yogurt alternatives → 1904, meat / cheese / other alternatives → 2806, ice cream alternatives → 5802 (differs from USDA).

rules.title: Survey-only categories
rules.text: 6489 *Vegetables on a sandwich*, 7702 *Tap water* and 9602 *Human milk* exist only for diet surveys. **Never** assign them to a product.

rules.title: Last resort
rules.text: 9999 *Not included in a food category* only for non-food items (pet food, cosmetics, cutlery) or a food that truly fits no definition. Target: < 1 % of products.
